newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crude grades make sharp gains on narrow arbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crude grades make sharp gains on narrow arbs.

text.p: U.S. crude differentials continued their firm stance to the close Wednesday, pumped by narrower West Texas Intermediate/Brent spreads, traders said.
High refinery runs have added to the refiner thirst for supplies, leaving sweet and sour grade values on firm ground.
On an outright basis, the deep declines seen late on the NYMEX market worked to pressure cash prices.

Losses were attributed to the American Petroleum Institute (API) report Tuesday showing larger-than-expected builds for distillates, reversing the prevailing trend for lower stocks, even if temporarily.
